annotations.title: Cutoff-time checker: does it make today's processing?

description: Cutoff-time checker: does it make today's processing? — Given a daily cutoff (HH:MM local) in an IANA time zone, says whether a submission made now (or at at=) beats today's cutoff, the effective processing date (rolling past weekends and US federal holidays), the next cutoff in local time and UTC, and a countdown in seconds. calendar=us (federal holidays with Sat->Fri / Sun->Mon observance, default), fed (Federal Reserve rules: Saturday holidays not observed) or none; weekends=true treats Sat/Sun as business days; days=N adds N business days after the processing date (e.g. settlement or ship date). Offline, deterministic. Use for payment, order, wire, shipping and support SLA cutoffs. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_cutoff
